effect.name: Wipe
effect.description: A straight-edged wipe at any angle, with an optional coloured leading edge. The workhorse scene transition - put it on a full-screen object and animate Amount.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Edge Colour
parameter.description: Colour of the band at the leading edge.

parameter.name: Amount
parameter.description: How far the wipe has travelled. Animate this.

parameter.name: Angle
parameter.description: Direction the wipe travels, in degrees.

parameter.name: Softness
parameter.description: How gradual the edge is. 0 is a hard line.

parameter.name: Edge Width
parameter.description: Width of the coloured leading band. 0 removes it.

parameter.name: Reverse
parameter.description: On wipes the object in instead of out.
